text: Inviting Comments from all persons likely to be affected F. No. P-13033/67/2024-EXPLOSIVE Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (Explosives Section) Dated: 2/ ~ une, 2024 Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, Ministry of Commerce and Industry has framed Recruitment Rules/Service Rules in the name of Indian Petroleum & Explosives Safety Services (IPESS) Rules, 2021 in respect of Group 'A' of the technical cadre of Petroleum & Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO). In this regard, it is proposed for appointment of one post of Director (Administration) in Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO), Headquarter, Nagpur through deputation method against the post of Junior Administrative Grade (Non-Functional) (Joint Chief Controller of Explosives) in the Pay Matrix Level-13 (Rs.1,23, 100-2, 15,900) under Indian Petroleum and Explosives Safety Service (IPESS), 2021. Accordingly, draft notification for amendment in Indian Petroleum and Explosives Safety Service Rules has been prepared. Comments, suggestions, etc. on the Draft Rules attached herewith are hereby invited from all stakeholders for consideration by the Department in view of Department of Personnel & Training OM NO. AB-14017/61 /2008- Estt. (RR) dated 13.10.2015. Stakeholders may submit their suggestions and objections, if any, within 30 days from the date of issue to Shri Pritam Kumar, Under Secretary (Explosives), Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, Room No. 460 'B', Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi, Email: pritam. k@gov.in.
